connection_role_names.0: solver visualization shell; no input part card
connection_role_names.1: structural continuum with shared mesh edges or faces
connection_role_names.6: structural beam connected at section endpoints

method: Cell assignment uses the original PartID, material card and parameter group, section and formulation group, solver element kind and connector role, then splits disconnected components. Solids must share a complete physical face, shells a perimeter edge, beams a physical endpoint. Native discrete springs and dampers retain their own solver kind. Repeated node slots in the original deck use true VTK wedge/tet/triangle topology. Cross-part interfaces remain boundaries. Mixed triangle/quad cells of the same shell section can belong to the same physical panel. Solver contact and constraint cards are described separately; the role field describes the element itself and does not encode the status of a contact at a time step.

connection_role_evidence.0: 结果文件中的五个可视化壳没有对应源部件或材料卡，源映射标明求解器生成。
connection_role_evidence.1: 壳共边或实体共整面构成部件内的网格连通性。单元的壳/实体类别来自源文件，默认的连续体角色不指定部件之间的装配工艺。
connection_role_evidence.2: 输入材料卡 *MAT_SPOTWELD，MID 2000486，部件 639_BeamSpotWelds，为源文件声明的点焊梁。
connection_role_evidence.3: 输入部件 Windshield_Adhesive，PID/MID 2000977。胶条功能据源部件名称识别，材料本构为 *MAT_PIECEWISE_LINEAR_PLASTICITY。部件名未给出每个胶条单元与玻璃或车身之间的配对。
connection_role_evidence.4: 输入材料卡 *MAT_SPRING_ELASTIC 或 *MAT_SPRING_NONLINEAR_ELASTIC，单元来自 *ELEMENT_DISCRETE。MID 2000491、2000493、2000494、2000496、2000924、5000002。
connection_role_evidence.6: 普通梁按照源梁单元的物理端点建立同部件连通性。梁的离散方向节点不参与端点相连判定。
connection_role_evidence.7: 源部件 PID 10001001 命名为 Wall，材料卡 MID 1001 为 *MAT_RIGID。
connection_role_evidence.8: 输入材料卡 *MAT_RIGID。标签描述刚性部件；其他部件与它的接触或约束由对应输入卡描述。
connection_role_evidence.9: 截面卡 *SECTION_DISCRETE；本数据的离散单元都已按弹簧或阻尼材料命名，此类别单元数为零。

constraint_source.interpretation: Constraint records appear on a primary region only if the referenced node or node-set member is on one of its actual cells. PartContactCandidateRoles is a part-set declaration and does not identify solved contact pairs. See the local deck and release-archive comparison in the referenced file.
